revision_summary: One quote timestamp needs correction and a couple of schema/labeling issues should be cleaned up on rerun: (1) In script_coverage's bill_collection row, the customer_quote 'Let's see. I don't have a hard copy, but I can go online. Let me' is timestamped 01:09 but actually occurs at 03:01 — 01:09 is the rep's question, not the customer's reply. Fix the ts. (2) The script_coverage section labeled 'tax_credit_qualifier' at 00:55-01:00 is mislabeled — this is the credit_qualifier (qualifiers.credit_qualifier) item, not a tax-credit disclosure; relabel and, since the rep states the threshold as '$6.70' (an odd/garbled restatement of 670), cross-reference this against the schema's known credit-threshold drift tracking (qualifiers.credit_qualifier.drift_observed) as a schema_drift_detection instance. (3) Add a cherry_pick_moment / coaching_focus entry for the co-owner disclosure at 00:26 ('Me and my daughter') — per protocols.adult_child_decision_maker, the rep should have asked whether the daughter should be included on the appointment; this was captured as a completed script item but never checked against the protocol, which is a real actionable gap the schema explicitly calls out. (4) Drop or re-source the speculative 'pre-existing satellite view' explanation for the tree question (03:14) — nothing in the transcript or schema supports this; either remove it or mark it explicitly as unfounded speculation. (5) The 'enthusiasm_signal' classification and its suggested coaching line ('That's great news for your system output') at 03:22 read as invented sales-theory phrasing not grounded in transcript or schema — reclassify more conservatively (e.g., as a minor missed-reinforcement note) or drop the invented verbatim suggestion. (6) The classification label 'unanchored_soft_exit' is not part of the schema's defined taxonomy — rename to an existing directive category (e.g., conditional_booking_detection) or flag it explicitly as a custom label. Outcome dispute (no_appointment) is well-supported and should stand as-is.
